newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takeda may list shares on NYSE in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Takeda may list shares on NYSE in 2000.

text.p: Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd said on Monday that the pharmaceuticals firm may list its shares on the New York Stock Exchange in 2000.

A company spokesman said that the company is drawing up a medium-term business plan for the period to 2000 which provides various business performance targets, including return-on-equity, that the company needs to reach if it aims to list its shares on the New York bourse.
However, the spokesman said that the company has not made a final decision on the listing yet.
He added that the company is aiming to meet global standards in order to compete with American and European drug giants in the international arena.
